facts.fact: Commissioner Bamba Karamoko of Cote d'Ivoire's CAIDP said law no. 2013-867 of 23 December 2013 guarantees anyone the right to obtain public documents from administrations.
The CAIDP recorded 45 referrals in 2024, 12 from journalists, and fines of up to 360,000 FCFA can be applied for breaches.
